paragraphs.text: translated by
1. IN perfect unison all yearning hymns of mine that find the light of heaven have sung forth Indra's praise.
paragraphs.original: अच्छा म इन्द्रं मतयः स्वर्विदः सध्रीचीर्विश्वा उशतीरनूषत ।
paragraphs.translit: acchā ma indraṃ matayaḥ svarvidaḥ sadhrīcīrviśvā uśatīranūṣata |

paragraphs.text: As wives embrace their lord, the comely bridegroom, so they compass Maghavan about that he may help.
paragraphs.original: परि ष्वजन्ते जनयो यथा पतिं मर्यं न शुन्ध्युं मघवानमूतये
paragraphs.translit: pari ṣvajante janayo yathā patiṃ maryaṃ na śundhyuṃ maghavānamūtaye

paragraphs.text: 2. Directed unto thee my spirit never strays, for I have set my hopes on thee, O Much-invoked!
paragraphs.original: न घा त्वद्रिगप वेति मे मनस्त्वे इत्कामं पुरुहूत शिश्रय ।
paragraphs.translit: na ghā tvadrigapa veti me manastve itkāmaṃ puruhūta śiśraya |

paragraphs.text: Sit, Wonderful! as King upon the sacred grass, and let thy drinking-place be by the Soma juice.
paragraphs.original: राजेव दस्म नि षदोऽधि बर्हिष्यस्मिन्सु सोमेऽवपानमस्तु ते
paragraphs.translit: rājeva dasma ni ṣado'dhi barhiṣyasminsu some'vapānamastu te

paragraphs.text: 3. From indigence and hunger Indra turns away: Maghavan hath dominion over precious wealth.
paragraphs.original: विषूवृदिन्द्रो अमतेरुत क्षुधः स इद्रायो मघवा वस्व ईशते ।
paragraphs.translit: viṣūvṛdindro amateruta kṣudhaḥ sa idrāyo maghavā vasva īśate |

paragraphs.text: These the Seven Rivers flowing on their downward path increase the vital vigour of the potent Steer.
paragraphs.original: तस्येदिमे प्रवणे सप्त सिन्धवो वयो वर्धन्ति वृषभस्य शुष्मिणः
paragraphs.translit: tasyedime pravaṇe sapta sindhavo vayo vardhanti vṛṣabhasya śuṣmiṇaḥ

paragraphs.text: 4. As on the fair-leafed tree rest birds, to Indra flow the gladdening Soma juices that the bowls contain.
paragraphs.original: वयो न वृक्षं सुपलाशमासदन्सोमास इन्द्रं मन्दिनश्चमूषदः ।
paragraphs.translit: vayo na vṛkṣaṃ supalāśamāsadansomāsa indraṃ mandinaścamūṣadaḥ |

paragraphs.text: Their face that glows with splendour through their mighty power hath found the shine of heaven for man, the Aryas' light.
paragraphs.original: प्रैषामनीकं शवसा दविद्युतद्विदत्स्वर्मनवे ज्योतिरार्यम्
paragraphs.translit: praiṣāmanīkaṃ śavasā davidyutadvidatsvarmanave jyotirāryam

paragraphs.text: 5. As in the game a gambler piles his winnings, so Maghavan, sweeping all together, gained the Sun
paragraphs.original: कृतं न श्वघ्नी वि चिनोति देवने संवर्गं यन्मघवा सूर्यं जयत् ।
paragraphs.translit: kṛtaṃ na śvaghnī vi cinoti devane saṃvargaṃ yanmaghavā sūryaṃ jayat |

paragraphs.text: This mighty deed of thine none other could achieve, none, Maghavan, before thee, none in recent time.
paragraphs.original: न तत्ते अन्यो अनु वीर्यं शकन्न पुराणो मघवन्नोत नूतनः
paragraphs.translit: na tatte anyo anu vīryaṃ śakanna purāṇo maghavannota nūtanaḥ

paragraphs.text: 6. Maghavan came by turns to all the tribes of men: the Steer took notice of the people's songs of praise.
paragraphs.original: विशंविशं मघवा पर्यशायत जनानां धेना अवचाकशद्वृषा ।
paragraphs.translit: viśaṃviśaṃ maghavā paryaśāyata janānāṃ dhenā avacākaśadvṛṣā |

paragraphs.text: The man in whose libations Sakra hath delight by means of potent Somas vanquisheth his foes.
paragraphs.original: यस्याह शक्रः सवनेषु रण्यति स तीव्रैः सोमैः सहते पृतन्यतः
paragraphs.translit: yasyāha śakraḥ savaneṣu raṇyati sa tīvraiḥ somaiḥ sahate pṛtanyataḥ

paragraphs.text: 7. When Soma streams together unto Indra flow like waters to the river, rivulets to the lake,
paragraphs.original: आपो न सिन्धुमभि यत्समक्षरन्सोमास इन्द्रं कुल्या इव ह्रदम् ।
paragraphs.translit: āpo na sindhumabhi yatsamakṣaransomāsa indraṃ kulyā iva hradam |

paragraphs.text: In place of sacrifice sages exalt his might, as the rain swells the corn by moisture sent from heaven.
paragraphs.original: वर्धन्ति विप्रा महो अस्य सादने यवं न वृष्टिर्दिव्येन दानुना
paragraphs.translit: vardhanti viprā maho asya sādane yavaṃ na vṛṣṭirdivyena dānunā

paragraphs.text: 8. He rushes through the region like a furious Bull, he who hath made these floods the dames of worthy lords.
paragraphs.original: वृषा न क्रुद्धः पतयद्रजस्स्वा यो अर्यपत्नीरकृणोदिमा अपः ।
paragraphs.translit: vṛṣā na kruddhaḥ patayadrajassvā yo aryapatnīrakṛṇodimā apaḥ |

paragraphs.text: This Maghavan hath found light for the man who brings oblation, sheds the juice, and promptly pours his gifts.
paragraphs.original: स सुन्वते मघवा जीरदानवेऽविन्दज्ज्योतिर्मनवे हविष्मते
paragraphs.translit: sa sunvate maghavā jīradānave'vindajjyotirmanave haviṣmate

paragraphs.text: 9. Let the keen axe come forth together with the light: here be, as erst, the teeming cow of sacrifice.
paragraphs.original: उज्जायतां परशुर्ज्योतिषा सह भूया ऋतस्य सुदुघा पुराणवत् ।
paragraphs.translit: ujjāyatāṃ paraśurjyotiṣā saha bhūyā ṛtasya sudughā purāṇavat |

paragraphs.text: Let the Red God shine bright with his refulgent ray, and let the Lord of heroes glow like heaven's clear sheen.
paragraphs.original: वि रोचतामरुषो भानुना शुचिः स्वर्ण शुक्रं शुशुचीत सत्पतिः
paragraphs.translit: vi rocatāmaruṣo bhānunā śuciḥ svarṇa śukraṃ śuśucīta satpatiḥ

paragraphs.text: 10. O Much-invoked, may we subdue all famine and evil want with store of grain and cattle.
paragraphs.original: गोभिष्टरेमामतिं दुरेवां यवेन क्षुधं पुरुहूत विश्वाम् ।
paragraphs.translit: gobhiṣṭaremāmatiṃ durevāṃ yavena kṣudhaṃ puruhūta viśvām |

paragraphs.text: May we allied, as first in rank, with princes obtain possessions by our own exertion.
paragraphs.original: वयं राजभिः प्रथमा धनान्यस्माकेन वृजनेना जयेम
paragraphs.translit: vayaṃ rājabhiḥ prathamā dhanānyasmākena vṛjanenā jayema

paragraphs.text: 11. Brhaspati protect us from the rearward, and from above, and from below, from sinners.
paragraphs.original: बृहस्पतिर्नः परि पातु पश्चादुतोत्तरस्मादधरादघायोः ।
paragraphs.translit: bṛhaspatirnaḥ pari pātu paścādutottarasmādadharādaghāyoḥ |

paragraphs.text: May Indra from the front, and from the centre, as Friend to friends, vouchsafe us room and freedom.
paragraphs.original: इन्द्रः पुरस्तादुत मध्यतो नः सखा सखिभ्यो वरिवः कृणोतु
paragraphs.translit: indraḥ purastāduta madhyato naḥ sakhā sakhibhyo varivaḥ kṛṇotu
